identity.name: Club Campus
identity.one_liner: The entry Nomos — a 36.4mm hand-wound with the Alpha manufacture caliber, designed as the first serious mechanical watch for students and young collectors.

narrative.story: The Club Campus is the entry point to Nomos's manufacture lineup: the same Alpha hand-wind movement as the Tangente, in a smaller 36.4mm case with a more casual dial. Nomos designed the Campus line for students and first-time buyers, and the caseback is engravable — a deliberate gesture toward the graduation-gift market. The Club Campus is the most-cited entry German manufacture watch and the watch a collector cites when they want Glashütte watchmaking under $2,000.
narrative.collector_notes: The Club line dates to 1992. The Campus variant (2017) uses the same Alpha movement but drops the date and simplifies the dial.
